light: This is one ordinary frame pulled from a normal handheld video shot by a friend with a consumer camera at eye level, simply recording what happens, not composing a photo. The framing is casual and a little off: something is cut by the edge of the frame. Almost everything in the frame is in focus, nothing blurred out: the cluttered background stays fully readable. The only light is what the place really has, and each person and object gets light according to where it stands; correctly exposed, the side near the opening a little brighter and cooler, the far corners dimmer. Colours of an ordinary video with automatic white balance and almost no correction: moderate contrast, soft highlights, mild sensor noise and light compression, faint motion blur on anything moving. Skin with pores, small blemishes and uneven tone; hair with stray strands; clothes with real creases, dust and wear. People are caught mid-action, unposed.
look: Ordinary handheld home video filmed by a friend with a consumer camera at eye level, small natural shakes and casual slightly imperfect framing, everything in the room in focus, only the light the place really has, correctly exposed, automatic white balance, mild sensor noise; real skin and natural hands; people move naturally and unposed, nothing staged; no music.

clips.text: Ahora sí, a llenar. Vuelco la carretilla dentro del marco, y con la pala la reparto hasta las esquinas.
clips.action: The wheelbarrow tips and the thick concrete with pebbles slides into the form; the shovel pushes it into the corner.

clips.text: Las esquinas y los bordes, con cuidado. Ahí es donde se hacen los huecos si no metes bien la mezcla.
clips.action: He pokes the concrete along the edge boards with the shovel blade, working it into the corners.

clips.text: Y ahora la regla. Una tabla recta, apoyada en el marco. La arrastro así, en zigzag, de un lado al otro, y lo que sobra se va.
clips.action: The straight board is dragged across the form in a zigzag, levelling the wet concrete and pushing the excess ahead.

clips.text: Donde queda un pozo, echo un poco de mezcla y paso la regla otra vez, hasta que quede parejo con el borde del marco.
clips.action: He drops a small shovelful of concrete into a low spot and passes the board over it again.

clips.text: Y este es el paso que casi nadie explica: aprieto las piedras con la llana. Suave, sin frotar, solo para hundirlas.
clips.action: The wooden float presses down gently and the pebbles sink until a thin film of grey paste covers them.

clips.text: Lo que quiero es que las piedras de arriba queden apenas tapadas por una capita de pasta. Que se adivinen debajo.
clips.action: Crouched, he points at the concrete surface with the float.

clips.text: Y ojo con alisar de más. Si lo trabajas mucho, sube agua y pasta a la superficie, y las piedras se hunden. Aprietas, y lo dejas.
clips.action: He lifts the float away from the concrete and shakes his head, talking.

clips.text: Hay una variante de esto que funciona todavía mejor cuando la piedra de color te sale cara.
clips.action: He looks straight into the camera with a knowing little smile while talking.

clips.text: Te dejé exactamente cómo hacerlo en la descripción.
clips.action: He nods and points down toward the bottom of the frame with one gloved finger.

clips.text: Y arriba le rocío esto, bien parejo. Qué es, te lo cuento en un rato, porque tiene su truco.
clips.action: The spray bottle mists a fine even layer of liquid over the fresh concrete surface.

clips.text: Y si hay mucho sol, lo tapo con un plástico levantado, que no toque la superficie. Así la cara de arriba no se seca antes que el resto.
clips.action: His hands spread a clear plastic sheet over thin sticks across the form so it hangs above the concrete without touching it.
